The '''''Doghouse''''' was a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] in use by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Arigo]], a member of the criminal organization the [[Exchange]],<ref name="Deceived" /> by [[3653 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'', which includes the appearance of the ''Doghouse'', to approximately [[3653 BBY]].</ref> To male Human [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Zeerid Korr]], it looked much like a [[Limb/Legends|legless]] [[Beetle/Legends|beetle]] with its [[Entry ramp/Legends|landing ramp]] stuck out of its belly like a tongue.<ref name="Deceived" />

The [[Starship/Legends|starship]] was on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] when Arigo was waiting for a munitions drop from Zeerid Korr. A rival group of criminals, later assumed by Korr to be either [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] or hired [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], took over the ''Doghouse'' at the drop point and waited for Korr to show up. When the smuggler arrived, the imposters tried to trick Korr into giving them the drop instead of Arigo. Korr surmised that they were not the ones who were supposed to pick up the cargo, and a short [[Skirmish on Ord Mantell (Doghouse)|battle]] ensued. The ship was left behind as Korr [[Death/Legends|killed]] the other criminals and escaped on ''[[Fatman]]''.<ref name="Deceived" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Doghouse'' first appeared in [[Paul S. Kemp]]'s [[2010]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''.<ref name="Deceived" />
